name: AshesUI (live element inspector)
description: A live inspector for any AXF app, switched on from the context menu (AshesUI, with a check mark while on). While on, a small headless tooltip follows the pointer and shows what is under it: framework component, active asset, the plugin or library it belongs to (and which model built it), size, colours with contrast, font, theme tokens, role. Double-click or double-tap opens a draggable, resizable inspector window: every element on screen in a tree (the selected one expanded and in view), its parameters in two tabs (Grid and Tree), live style and attribute edits with revert, copy selector / JSON / HTML, pick mode, keyboard walking, freeze, filters (all / framework / plugins) and stats. Built Oct 23 2026 (Opus).

parts.label: Live tooltip
parts.description: A small window that follows the pointer with what's under it.

parts.label: Highlight box
parts.description: Outlines the element under the pointer, with margin and padding shading.

parts.label: Inspector window
parts.description: Double-click or double-tap opens the element tree with every parameter in a Grid and a Tree tab.

parts.label: Live edits
parts.description: Change an element's style and attributes in the grid; every change can be reverted.

parts.label: Plugin and library owners
parts.description: Says which plugin or library an element belongs to, and which model built it (the app passes its plugin list).
